problems: The figure is not a gull silhouette. The only filled-looking shape is a small blue outline at about (160-205, 140-210), which is not built from the key stars and is not a bird with wings. It reads at most as a bell or bottle.

The gold lines are a thin skeleton (head to body centre, body centre to left wingtip, body centre to tail), not a filled body oval or wing shapes. The body centre star 93194 at about (320, 297) has no filled oval around it.

Stars are not on the right parts. The breast star 93017 and the right wingtip star 92420 both sit near (374, 276), so the breast and right wingtip collide. The tail star 93279 at about (314, 313) sits right against the body centre instead of forming a forked fan at the lower end.

Labels overlap badly: 'breast, where the neck flares' and 'body centre, the brightest s' are printed on top of each other near (340-460, 280), and 'left wingtip' collides with the body-centre label near (280-400, 290). The labels cannot be read.
The orientation is roughly correct (head at top, tail at bottom), but the wings sit at the same height as the body centre and there is no neck flare, so the silhouette does not read as a gull.

Most of the other stars (for example (234,108), (218,137), (123,241), (162,384), (408,471)) are unlabelled background field stars, which is fine, but they make the key stars look like random dots rather than a figure.
output.advice: Redraw as a filled gull silhouette, not as gold stick lines. Use the key stars as anchor points on the outline of the shape. (1) Head 92791: put it at the crown of a small rounded head near (345, 174), the top of the figure. (2) Breast 93017: move it below the head along the neck, where the neck flares into the chest, about (330-340, 240-255), not at the right edge near (374, 276). (3) Body centre 93194: keep it at about (320, 297) and fill an oval around it roughly 60 px wide and 70 px tall, spanning about (290-350, 262-332). (4) Tail 93279: move it lower so it marks a forked fan at the bottom of the body, about (305-335, 335-355), with two prongs. (5) Wingtips: keep 93917 at about (269, 302) on the left and place 92420 at the mirror point about (371, 290) on the right, so the wings spread from the body's sides at its upper-middle height, with the primaries on the outer edge. Fill the wings and body as a solid shape. Lighten the gold lines so they only trace the outline. Separate the labels: stack them in a column on the right with leader lines so 'breast' and 'body centre' do not overlap. Remove or move the unrelated blue outline shape away from the figure so it does not read as a second object.
